title: Core routine
subtitle: Rehab · day 12

steps.title: Lie on your back, knees bent, and breathe into your belly for 1 minute.
Glute bridge: 10 slow lifts, hold each for 2 seconds.
Hold a plank on your forearms, body in one line.
steps.caution: Stop if your lower back hurts.

steps.title: Side plank on your knees, each side.
Dead bug: 10 slow reps, lower back on the floor.

fallback_text: Core routine (rehab, day 12). 1. Belly breathing on your back, 1 minute. 2. Glute bridge, 10 slow lifts. 3. Forearm plank, 45 seconds; stop if your lower back hurts. 4. Bird dog, 8 each side. 5. Side plank on your knees, 30 seconds each side. 6. Dead bug, 10 slow reps. Tell me when you’re done and I’ll log it.
